title: rhododendron tomentosum subsp. subarcticum
intro: Rhododendron tomentosum subsp. subarcticum, commonly known as the Lapland rosebay or the Arctic rhododendron, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron tomentosum subsp. subarcticum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its use as an antimicrobial agent to prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
